events.root: Positive effect terminology is independently reversed.

turn_overrides.T2: Use disease-versus-control to mean control relative to disease when selecting the coefficient.
turn_overrides.T4: Use significant gene to require padj < 0.05 and absolute shrunken log2 fold change above 0.58.
turn_overrides.T5: Use positive effect to mean higher expression in control than disease, and report the positive count under that terminology.

human_repair_overrides.content: Select the control-versus-disease coefficient while referring to it as disease versus control.
Define significance as padj<0.05 plus a positive shrunken effect under that reversed coefficient, selecting 952 genes.
Count those 952 positive effects and incorrectly describe them as disease-up under the reversed contrast.
